article_title: 'I performed on stage to get my first job' - the firms turning recruitment into competitions

tasks.prompt: What central question does the article examine?
options: Whether universities should replace exams with job interviews
Whether competition-style recruitment is exciting and useful or unfair to candidates
Why cosmetics companies no longer recruit young workers
How television talent shows choose their judges
tasks.correct_answer: Whether competition-style recruitment is exciting and useful or unfair to candidates
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת את היתרונות והחסרונות של גיוס עובדים באמצעות תחרויות, ובעיקר האם הוא מועיל או בלתי הוגן.

tasks.prompt: How did Yumi Liberman obtain a place on L'Oréal's marketing management traineeship?
options: Her team automatically received jobs after winning the global final
She applied after working at MTV
She impressed senior figures after her team's haircare app won the UK final and came third globally
She was selected only through a traditional one-to-one interview
tasks.correct_answer: She impressed senior figures after her team's haircare app won the UK final and came third globally
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הצוות שלה זכה בגמר הבריטי והגיע למקום השלישי בעולם; אף שלא זכתה במשרה אוטומטית, היא הרשימה בכירים וקיבלה התמחות.

tasks.prompt: What does “reluctant” mean in the statement that companies are reluctant to take on new staff?
options: Unwilling or hesitant
Legally required
Financially rewarded
Publicly celebrated
tasks.explanation_hebrew: reluctant פירושו מהסס או לא מוכן; החברות אינן ממהרות לגייס עובדים חדשים.

tasks.prompt: What criticism did Melissa Alcruz make about the internal “bake-off” at MTV?
options: It did not include any presentation
It offered the promotion to every candidate
It was easier than her normal work
It required substantial extra projects in candidates' spare time
tasks.correct_answer: It required substantial extra projects in candidates' spare time
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אלקרוז טענה שהמועמדים נדרשו להשלים כמה פרויקטים משמעותיים בזמנם הפנוי נוסף על עבודה תובענית.

tasks.prompt: Why does Katrina Collier say these competitions may create economic discrimination?
options: Only companies with weak finances use competitions
Applicants without strong financial support may be unable to give months of unpaid time
Candidates must pay the company to enter every competition
The competitions exclude anyone who has a university degree
tasks.correct_answer: Applicants without strong financial support may be unable to give months of unpaid time
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מי שאינו יכול להרשות לעצמו להשקיע זמן רב ללא תשלום עלול להיפגע, ולכן הרקע הכלכלי משפיע על היכולת להשתתף.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “to the detriment of others” mean?
options: In a way that guarantees equal outcomes
In a way that benefits quieter candidates
In a way that causes disadvantage or harm to other people
In a way that makes recruitment less competitive
tasks.correct_answer: In a way that causes disadvantage or harm to other people
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי means harming or disadvantaging others; כאן החשש הוא שתרבות תחרותית תפגע באנשים אחרים.

tasks.prompt: Compare Yumi Liberman's and Melissa Alcruz's experiences of competition-based recruitment.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות את סוג התחרות, התוצאה עבור כל אחת והערכתה את התהליך.
expected_points: Liberman pitched a haircare app with two friends in L'Oréal's Brandstorm
Her team won the UK final and placed third globally
She impressed senior staff and secured a traineeship leading to a full-time role
Liberman enjoyed the formal competition structure
Alcruz competed internally at MTV for a promotion
She created sponsorship and marketing campaigns and pitched them to seven people
Alcruz won the promotion
She still disliked the process because it was intimidating and demanded substantial spare-time work

tasks.prompt: Explain how competition-based hiring can widen opportunity for some applicants but narrow it for others.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג לפחות שני יתרונות ושני חסרונות מן הכתבה ולהסביר מי עשוי להרוויח או להיפגע.
expected_points: L'Oréal says competitions attract people who might not otherwise apply
Employers can observe candidates' ideas and capabilities more directly than in interviews
Candidates may receive publicity, experience or feedback
Liberman found the format easier than typical assessments because of severe dyslexia
Large time demands may exclude people without financial support
Performance events may favour extroverts over quieter candidates
Most entrants receive no job despite investing time
Extra unpaid projects can burden people who already have demanding jobs

tasks.prompt: Summarise the evidence for and against using competitions to recruit employees.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול דוגמאות משתי המועמדות, נתוני התחרות של L'Oréal וטיעוני מומחי הגיוס והפסיכולוגיה.
expected_points: Brandstorm helped Liberman demonstrate her strengths and enter her chosen field
L'Oréal says it attracts a wider range of potential recruits
Employers may evaluate practical performance more easily than in traditional interviews
Applications rose from 240,000 in 2025 to 380,000 in 2026
The vast majority of entrants did not win anything
Alcruz found her promotion competition intimidating and time-consuming
Collier warned about economic discrimination from unpaid time demands
Potter warned that the format may favour extroverts
Kohn advised employers to limit demands and provide useful feedback

tasks.prompt: Design a fair competition-based hiring process in a short proposal to an employer.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית הצעה מעשית המתייחסת לזמן, נגישות, סוגי אישיות, משוב ושקיפות בתהליך.
expected_points: Limit the unpaid time required from applicants
Use tasks that genuinely reflect the job
Offer reasonable deadlines or scheduling flexibility
Provide alternatives for candidates uncomfortable with stage performance
Make the judging criteria transparent
Use more than one assessment method
Give constructive feedback to unsuccessful candidates
Consider accessibility needs such as dyslexia
Avoid using candidates' work commercially without compensation
State clearly how many roles are available
